    minr = min(r for r, c in points)

    shape = [(r-minr, c-minc) for r, c in points]
    maxr = max(r for r, c in shape)
    maxc = max(c for r, c in shape)
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for dr in range(h-maxr):
        for dc in range(w-maxc):
            cells = [(dr+r, dc+c) for r, c in shape]
